translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 26.10.2016 (radio)

More sexual crimes are being reported to the police than before. Russian warships have come to the Baltic Sea. In France police officers demand safer working conditions. Winter speed limits are coming into force on Finland's roads. Saara Aalto is attracting viewers on YouTube.
## Sexual crimes are reported more readily
![The Pasila police building.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9090970)
Open image viewer
The police get many reports of sexual crimes. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Many more reports of rapes and other sexual crimes are being made to the police than before.
This year, by the end of September, about 2,500 sexual crimes had been reported to the police. That is about 20 percent more than a year earlier.
Foreign citizens are more and more often suspected of sexual crimes. Of all suspects, the share of foreigners is about 20 percent.
The police say that the number of sexual crimes may not have grown, but people report them to the police more readily than before.
## Russian warships came to the Baltic Sea
![Map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9252115)
Open image viewer
The Russian warships may be on their way to Kaliningrad. Photo: Yle News Graphics
Two Russian warships have come to the Baltic Sea. The ships came into the Baltic Sea through the Danish straits on Tuesday.
Swedish newspapers say that the ships can carry nuclear weapons. The ships may be on their way to Kaliningrad.
The ships belong to Russia's Black Sea Fleet. At first it was thought that they were on their way to Syria.
## Work safety worries French police officers
![Police officers' demonstration.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9252034)
Open image viewer
French police officers have demonstrated for better work safety for more than a week already. Photo: Juha Nurminen / Yle
In France police officers are demonstrating against poor working conditions.
Attacks against the police have increased. This year more than 3,000 police officers have already been injured.
For example, a couple of weeks ago in the town of Viry-Chatillon, south of Paris, a group of young people surrounded a police car and set it on fire.
The police officers demand better work safety. They want, for example, the law on police use of weapons to be reconsidered.
## Winter speed limits come into force this week
![A speed limit sign is changed to the winter speed.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-8452599)
Open image viewer
The winter speed limits come into force as soon as the traffic signs have been changed. Photo: Yle
Finland's roads are switching to winter speed limits this week. The new speed limits come into force as soon as the traffic signs have been changed.
Winter speed limits mean that cars must drive more slowly.
For example, on the motorway a car's speed may be at most 100 kilometres per hour, and on other roads 80 kilometres per hour.
## Saara Aalto is also successful on YouTube
![Saara Aalto](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9247298)
Open image viewer
Saara Aalto's videos get many viewers on YouTube.  Photo: Syco / Thames / Dymond / AOP
Finnish singer Saara Aalto's YouTube videos are getting many viewers.
Saara Aalto is taking part in Britain's X Factor singing competition. Aalto's videos get many more viewers on YouTube than those of the other X Factor contestants.

For example, Aalto's newest video Oh So Quiet has been watched more than 1.6 million times. The newest video of Matt Terry, the X Factor pre-competition favourite, has been watched about 300,000 times.
At the moment there are still 9 contestants in X Factor. The 3 best will get to the final.
